name: Wainuiomata 2026
information: Wainuiomata 2026 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. This competition is open to all competitors regardless of age, experience, or skill. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary. Please make sure to read all the information in the tabs before registering. All competitors should be familiar with the information in these tabs.
